title: Graton Casino Expansion
summary: This note details the management of the Graton Casino Expansion, a $2.9M project, where the owner coordinated between internal teams and external stakeholders. The primary challenge involved balancing customer desires for premium customizations against vendor timeline constraints and internal concerns about scope creep. The process involved establishing weekly coordination meetings and presenting options to the client to ensure on-schedule delivery.

key_points.text: Coordinated between internal teams and external stakeholders including architects, general contractors, and global supply vendors
Challenge involved competing priorities: customer wanted premium customizations, vendors pushed back on timeline, internal team worried about scope creep
Delivered the project with over $400k in customizations on schedule
